research_protocol.confirmation_isolation: Distinct declared development and confirmation streams and namespaces, frozen package/protocol, prompt-only candidate; workflow separation under shared Unix identity, no technically protected confirmation.

research_protocol.hypothesis: Prefix reuse can lower native prompt work without meeting the absolute task-quality gate; any quality-valid service improvement can be weakened by full-attempt and allocation costs.
research_protocol.question: When is measured native same-input prefix reuse a quality-valid efficiency result under exact-answer and token-parity gates?

Development seed830091 requests8; only if all four arms reach8/8 and exact paired token parity, freeze confirmation seed830129 requests128. No family/context/seed search or replacement. Declining confirmation after futility is not a confirmation finding.
research_protocol.stopping_rule: One development execution, no retries. If any arm below8/8, parity failure, protocol failure or interruption, stop and propose historical-audit-only alternative to root. If feasible, exactly one confirmation execution. At most544 native requests and1200 seconds native execution; original allocation deadline310468865220540. Stop on resource exhaustion/cancellation/identity failure; retain every attempt.
research_protocol.uncertainty: Report all balanced pair effects and min/median/max, request-level correct-to-wrong and wrong-to-correct transitions, exact token differences, nearest-rank p50/p95/p99. No IID request or significance inference.
